configurations.name: shift-digital
runtimeArgs: import os,http.server; port=int(os.environ.get('PORT') or 5173); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=True; s=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',port),http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler); print('serving http://127.0.0.1:%d' % port, flush=True); s.serve_forever()

configurations.name: shift-digital-dist
runtimeArgs: import os,http.server,functools; port=int(os.environ.get('PORT') or 5174); h=functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler,directory='dist'); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=True; s=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',port),h); print('serving dist on http://127.0.0.1:%d' % port, flush=True); s.serve_forever()
